The option giving 3 matches 2b + 4 against the right side's constant 10 rather than its x-coefficient 14, and it likewise leaves a solvable equation. The option giving 13 lumps each side's x-coefficient and constant together, 2b + 4 - 6 = 14 + 10, so 2b = 26.
rationale: Lumps each side's coefficient and constant together, 2b + 4 - 6 = 14 + 10, so 2b = 26 and b = 13.
